description: This file defines the CalendarSyncJobManager class, responsible for managing calendar synchronization jobs within a SuiteCRM environment. It includes methods to check if account-level or meeting-level jobs are active, utilizing the JobStatusHelper and interacting with the SchedulersJobs bean.

classes.name: CalendarSyncJobManager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing and checking the status of calendar synchronization jobs.

methods.name: accountJobIsActive
methods.description: Checks whether an account-level synchronization job is active for a given calendar account ID.

methods.name: getActiveMeetingJobCount
methods.description: Counts the number of active meeting-level synchronization jobs for a specified calendar sync operation.

methods.name: meetingJobIsActive
methods.description: Determines if the meeting job is currently active for a given calendar sync operation.
